prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: All equipment must comply with the safety standard.
All equipment must comply the safety standard.
All equipment must complying with the safety standard.
All equipment must be complied with the safety standard.
answer: All equipment must comply with the safety standard.

wrong.All equipment must comply the safety sta: comply 是不及物動詞，後面要加 with 才能接標準；中文「遵守」容易讓人直接接受詞。
wrong.All equipment must complying with the sa: must 後面要接原形動詞，不能用 complying。
wrong.All equipment must be complied with the: 設備是主動去符合標準，不是被遵守，而且 be complied with 後面又多接了 with，語意混亂。

why: comply with 是固定片語，助動詞 must 後面接原形 comply。
tip: comply with，後面一定要有 with。
say: All equipment must comply with the safety standard.

prompt: 視訊會議時，你想請客戶再說一次剛才的驗收日期，因為網路有點不穩。哪一句最自然禮貌？
options: Sorry, the connection broke up. Could you repeat the acceptance date?
Sorry, your acceptance date again, please say.
Sorry, I am not hear the acceptance date.
Repeat the acceptance date now, please.
answer: Sorry, the connection broke up. Could you repeat the acceptance date?

wrong.Sorry, your acceptance date again, pleas: 語序受中文影響，英文要說 Could you repeat ...? 這種完整問句。
wrong.Sorry, I am not hear the acceptance date: am not hear 是 be 動詞加原形動詞的錯誤，應說 I didn't catch 或 I couldn't hear。
文法沒錯，但是對客戶用命令句加 now 顯得不禮貌，不適合商務視訊場合。

why: 先說明原因，再用 Could you ...? 提出請求，是商務場合最自然禮貌的說法。
say: Sorry, the connection broke up. Could you repeat the acceptance date?

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The machine is covered by a one-year _____, so the supplier will repair it free of charge if it fails.
options: warranty
warrant
warning
warehouse

wrong.warrant: warrant 是「令狀、搜索票」或動詞「證明正當」，不是保固。
wrong.warning: warning 是「警告」，與免費維修的保固不同。
wrong.warehouse: warehouse 是「倉庫」，不能放在 one-year 後面形容保固。

why: free of charge 的維修承諾就是保固，warranty 是名詞「保固、保證書」。
tip: warranty 是保固，注意與 warrant 不同。
say: The machine is covered by a one-year warranty, so the supplier will repair it free of charge if it fails.

text: The inspector will sign off the project once all open issues have been closed.
options: 待處理事項全部結案後，檢查員才會簽核專案。
檢查員已經簽核專案，所以事項都不用處理了。
檢查員會在專案開始前關閉所有會議。
只要有一項待處理事項，專案就會自動結案。
answer: 待處理事項全部結案後，檢查員才會簽核專案。

wrong.檢查員已經簽核專案，所以事項都不用處理了。: will sign off 是未來式，once 又指出條件，簽核在事項結案之後才發生。
wrong.檢查員會在專案開始前關閉所有會議。: 原句沒有提到會議，而且 issues 是待解決的問題，不是會議。
wrong.只要有一項待處理事項，專案就會自動結案。: once all open issues have been closed 說的是全部事項都結案，意思相反。

why: once 引導條件，all open issues 結案後才簽核。
tip: sign off 是簽核、正式批准。
say: The inspector will sign off the project once all open issues have been closed.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The instruments are calibrated according to the ISO procedure.
The instruments calibrate according to the ISO procedure by the lab.
The instruments are calibrate according to the ISO procedure.
The instruments are calibrated according with the ISO procedure.
answer: The instruments are calibrated according to the ISO procedure.

wrong.The instruments calibrate according to t: 儀器不會自己校準，要用被動語態 are calibrated，主動式加 by the lab 也變得矛盾。
wrong.The instruments are calibrate according: 被動語態要用 be 動詞加過去分詞，calibrate 要改成 calibrated。
wrong.The instruments are calibrated according: according 的固定搭配是 according to，不是 according with。

why: 儀器是被校準，所以用被動式；according to 是固定片語。
tip: according to，被動式用 be + p.p.
say: The instruments are calibrated according to the ISO procedure.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The two companies signed a contract that is legally _____ on both sides.
options: binding
bonding
blinding
building

wrong.bonding: bonding 是「黏合、建立情感連結」，不是有法律拘束力。
wrong.blinding: blinding 是「刺眼的」，與合約無關。
wrong.building: building 是「建築物」，放在 legally 後面語意不通。

why: legally binding 是固定搭配，表示具有法律約束力。
tip: legally binding 指法律上有約束力。
say: The two companies signed a contract that is legally binding on both sides.

prompt: 你在跨國會議中想確認：下週五是不是專案的最後期限？哪一句最適合？
options: Just to confirm, is next Friday the final deadline for the project?
Just to confirm, next Friday is the deadline final project?
Just to confirm, does next Friday the final deadline?
Just to confirm, are next Friday final deadline for the project?
answer: Just to confirm, is next Friday the final deadline for the project?

wrong.Just to confirm, next Friday is the dead: 形容詞 final 要放在名詞 deadline 前面，而且 project 要用 for 連接。
wrong.Just to confirm, does next Friday the fi: does 是助動詞，後面還需要原形動詞；這句的主要動詞其實是 be 動詞。
wrong.Just to confirm, are next Friday final d: next Friday 是單數，要用 is，並且 deadline 前要加 the。

why: 確認事實用 be 動詞疑問句，Just to confirm 是商務會議中的客氣開場。
tip: 確認資訊：Just to confirm, is ...?
say: Just to confirm, is next Friday the final deadline for the project?

text: The supplier has promised to replace any defective part at no extra cost.
options: 供應商承諾免費更換任何有缺陷的零件。
供應商要求客戶付額外費用更換零件。
供應商承諾退還所有已使用的零件。
供應商將把有缺陷的零件賣給別的公司。
answer: 供應商承諾免費更換任何有缺陷的零件。

wrong.供應商要求客戶付額外費用更換零件。: at no extra cost 是「不需額外費用」，這個選項說要付費，剛好相反。
wrong.供應商承諾退還所有已使用的零件。: replace 是更換，不是退還；而且 defective 是有缺陷的，不是已使用的。
wrong.供應商將把有缺陷的零件賣給別的公司。: 原句完全沒有提到賣給其他公司，只談更換有缺陷的零件。

why: replace 表示更換，defective 是有缺陷的，at no extra cost 是不收額外費用。
tip: at no extra cost 是免費、不另收費。
say: The supplier has promised to replace any defective part at no extra cost.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Please wear protective equipment before you enter this area.
Please wearing protective equipment before you enter this area.
Please wear protective equipment before you will enter this area.
Please wear a protective equipments before you enter this area.
answer: Please wear protective equipment before you enter this area.

wrong.Please wearing protective equipment befo: 祈使句用原形動詞開頭，不能用 wearing。
wrong.Please wear protective equipment before: before 引導的時間子句用現在式，不使用 will。
wrong.Please wear a protective equipments befo: equipment 是不可數名詞，不能加 a，也不能加 s。

why: 祈使句用原形，時間子句用現在式，equipment 是不可數名詞。
tip: equipment 不可數，不加 a 也不加 s。
say: Please wear protective equipment before you enter this area.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The customer will not accept the delivery until the final _____ test is completed.
options: acceptance
accepting
acceptable
accepted

wrong.accepting: accepting 是動詞 -ing 形，acceptance test 需要名詞形式修飾 test。
wrong.acceptable: acceptable 是「可接受的」，acceptable test 指的是品質尚可的測試，不是驗收測試。
wrong.accepted: accepted test 是「被接受的測試」，意思不同，不是業界的固定名詞片語。

why: acceptance test 是固定名詞組合，意思是驗收測試。
say: The customer will not accept the delivery until the final acceptance test is completed.

prompt: 工程師想請同事確認新標籤已經寄出，哪一句最自然？
options: Could you confirm that the updated labels have been sent?
Could you confirm the updated labels to be sent have?
Could you confirmed that the updated labels sent?
Could you confirm that the updated labels are sending?
answer: Could you confirm that the updated labels have been sent?

wrong.Could you confirm the updated labels to: 語序混亂，have 不能放在句尾，被動完成式應該是 have been sent。
wrong.Could you confirmed that the updated lab: Could 後面要接原形 confirm，而且 sent 前面缺少 have been。
wrong.Could you confirm that the updated label: are sending 表示標籤自己在寄東西，應該用被動完成式表示已經寄出。

why: 標籤是被寄出，而且要確認已完成，所以用現在完成被動式 have been sent。
tip: 已經被完成的事：have been + p.p.
say: Could you confirm that the updated labels have been sent?

prompt: in accordance with 在這句話裡是什麼意思？
text: The test was carried out in accordance with the customer's instructions.
options: 依照
反對
代替
超過

wrong.反對: 反對是 in opposition to 或 against；測試是照客戶指示做的，不是違反。
wrong.代替: 代替是 instead of 或 in place of，這句沒有人被取代。
wrong.超過: 超過是 beyond 或 exceed，這裡沒有比較程度的意思。

why: in accordance with 表示按照、依照，常用在規定與指示前面。
tip: in accordance with = 依照、符合。
say: The test was carried out in accordance with the customer's instructions.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The audit verified that the supplier meets every requirement.
The audit verified that the supplier meet every requirement.
The audit verify that the supplier meets every requirement.
The audit verified that the supplier meets every requirements.
answer: The audit verified that the supplier meets every requirement.

wrong.The audit verified that the supplier mee: supplier 是單數，現在式動詞要用 meets。
wrong.The audit verify that the supplier meets: audit 查核已經發生，且主詞為單數，不應該使用原形 verify。
wrong.The audit verified that the supplier mee: every 後面接單數名詞，要寫 every requirement，不是 requirements。

why: every 後面接單數名詞，supplier 是單數主詞，動詞加 s。
say: The audit verified that the supplier meets every requirement.

prompt: 你在跨國專案中，想委婉表示「保固期間的零件更換範圍，我們需要再確認」。哪一句最適合？
options: We need to clarify what the warranty covers for parts replacement.
We need clarify what the warranty cover parts replacing.
We need to clarify what covers the warranty for replace parts.
We need to clarifying what is the warranty cover parts.
answer: We need to clarify what the warranty covers for parts replacement.

wrong.We need clarify what the warranty cover: need 後面要接 to + 原形，且 warranty 是單數，動詞要用 covers。
wrong.We need to clarify what covers the warra: 主詞和受詞顛倒，意思變成「什麼東西涵蓋保固」，而且 for 後面要接名詞 replacement。
wrong.We need to clarifying what is the warran: to 後面不能接 -ing，而且名詞子句不能用疑問句語序加 is。

why: need to + 原形，名詞子句 what the warranty covers 使用肯定句語序。
tip: 間接問句用肯定句語序：what + 主詞 + 動詞。
say: We need to clarify what the warranty covers for parts replacement.
